records.text: Rendow is a leather armor merchant in Feralas who provides goods and repair service.
Tarhus is a reagent seller in Feralas who also has tasks for visitors.
Jadenvis Seawatcher is a reagent seller in Feralas who also has tasks for visitors.

Shandris Feathermoon is a general of the Sentinel Army who balances operations against the Hatecrest naga with protecting Feathermoon Stronghold. Her deputy Latronicus Moonspear monitors the naga forces. She takes reports of threats seriously and values bravery from those helping the stronghold.
Falfindel Waywarder is a wise druid at Thalanaar who can call forest spirits to aid the Charred Vale. He urges them to hurry and says the campaign against Charlga Razorflank must continue.
Thyssiana is a hippogryph master who offers fast travel. When attacked, she calls for the guards and summons an enraged hippogryph.

Krueg Skullsplitter is an Orgrimmar agent in Feralas who travels with companions on a mission for his masters. He wants to please his life-mate Korrin with a sprite-darter-wing cloak, yet also pursues the Grimtotem for Belgrom Rockmaul. After urging a bounty hunt, he lets the adventurer keep the horns and carry them to Belgrom, saying the work deserves the reward.
A Gordunni Ogre is a hostile member of the ogre tribe occupying parts of Feralas. It bellows blunt threats to smash or crush its foe, and can also cast a spell.
A Gordunni Brute is a hostile ogre of the Gordunni tribe, found across several parts of Feralas. Like other Gordunni ogres it shouts threats to smash and crush, and it hits with a forceful Uppercut.
A Gordunni ogre mauler from the tribe's Feralas stronghold, who answers intruders with blunt threats to smash and crush them. It closes to fight with Thrash.

A Gordunni shaman guarding the tribe’s Feralas territory, this ogre meets intruders with threats to smash and crush them. The Gordunni have occupied the High Wilderness ruins, where their presence endangers those investigating the area.
A Gordunni ogre mage stationed at the tribe's Feralas outpost, a hostile caster who threatens to crush intruders and holds its ground rather than advancing.
A Gordunni battlemaster from the tribe’s Feralas stronghold, this brute threatens to smash or crush intruders. Its battle cry demoralizes opponents as it enters combat.
A Gordunni mage-lord among the tribe’s forces in Feralas, this hostile caster threatens to smash or crush intruders and attacks with Fireball.
A Gordunni ogre warlock guarding the High Wilderness. It meets intruders with blunt threats and attacks anyone who enters its territory.
A Gordunni ogre warlord of the High Wilderness who answers intruders with threats and can unleash an Echoing Roar.
A Zukk'ash stinger: an insect that fights with its sting. When pressed, it makes one last desperate attempt to sting its victim.
A Zukk'ash wasp found in the Feralas region. It attacks intruders with a sting.
A Zukk'ash worker, one of the insect creatures found in Feralas.
A Zukk'ash tunneler, a creature found in Feralas.
A Woodpaw gnoll who snarls about fresh meat and bones to gnaw on, and growls the rest.

A Woodpaw gnoll whose few words turn to fresh meat and bones, with growls filling out the rest of its speech. This trapper shares the pack's blunt, appetite-centered voice; it casts a spell when attacked.
A Woodpaw gnoll whose few words turn to fresh meat and bones, with growls filling out the rest of its speech. The brute has the same blunt, appetite-centered voice as its kin.
A Woodpaw gnoll mystic who snarls about fresh meat and bones, growls the rest, and casts Lightning Bolt in battle.
A Woodpaw gnoll reaver who snarls about fresh meat and bones, growls the rest, and casts a spell when it attacks.

A Woodpaw gnoll whose few words turn to fresh meat and bones, with growls filling out the rest of its speech. As an Alpha, it belongs to the leaders Hadoken Swiftstrider seeks to eliminate to disrupt gnoll ranks; its own voice remains blunt and appetite-centered.
A Groddoc ape, a large wild primate of Feralas.
A Groddoc thunderer, a beast of Feralas that fights with Thunderclap.
An Ironfur bear native to Feralas, encountered across several parts of the region. It lashes out with a combat spell when fighting.
An older, grizzled Ironfur bear of Feralas, found across several areas. Like other Ironfur bears, it uses a combat spell when fighting.
An Ironfur patriarch, a mature bear of Feralas that lets out a Demoralizing Roar in a fight.
A Sprite Dragon found in Feralas, a small dragonkin creature. It uses a combat spell when fighting.
Sprite darters are faerie dragons sought for their iridescent wings, which can adorn a cloak. A sprite-darter egg is described as fragile, with a hatchling that may be raised as a pet.
The Longtooth Runner is a wild beast found across several areas. It responds to aggression by casting a combat spell, making it a dangerous member of the local wildlife.
The Longtooth Howler is a wild beast of Feralas.
A Rabid Longtooth is a dangerous wild beast found in two areas of Feralas, the rabid kind among the longtooths.
The Feral Scar Yeti is a wild humanoid.
Hulking Feral Scars are large humanoid creatures found in multiple areas. Their name identifies them with the Feral Scar population and marks their imposing size.
Enraged Feral Scar is a hostile fighter of Feralas that flies into a rage when badly wounded.
A Rage Scar Yeti flies into a rage when badly wounded.
An Elder Rage Scar lets out a Battle Roar as it joins a fight.
A Ferocious Rage Scar tears at its foes with Rend Flesh.
A Frayfeather Hippogryph, a beast of Feralas.
A Frayfeather Stagwing is a beast that swoops in combat.
Frayfeather Skystormer is a large bird of Feralas that summons a Lightning Cloud in a fight.
Frayfeather Patriarch is a large bird found in Feralas.
A Vale Screecher is a large bird of Feralas that casts a spell in a fight, even when badly wounded.
A Rogue Vale Screecher is a large bird of Feralas that casts a spell as it fights.
Lethlas is a lone dragonkin in Feralas who fights with spells.
Jademir Oracles are named as a group found in Feralas. This oracle is a heavily built creature and uses Rejuvenation when it draws an enemy into combat.
A Jademir Tree Warder is a creature found around Jademir Lake. It uses Entangling Roots when attacked and Faerie Fire when a foe draws its attention.
A Jademir Boughguard is a dragonkin guardian around Jademir Lake that cleaves nearby foes and strikes with Mortal Strike.
Coast Crawl Snapclaws are creatures found along the coast in several areas of the zone.
A Coast Crawl Deepseer is a creature found along the coast. It can cast Frost Armor while out of combat.
Hatecrest Warriors are fighters of Feralas's coastal areas who can disarm a foe.
Hatecrest Wave Riders are found along Feralas's coast and can call up a Geyser in a fight.
A Hatecrest Serpent Guard opens a fight with a blast of Frost Shock.
A Hatecrest Myrmidon opens a fight by throwing a Net over its foe.
A Hatecrest Screamer attacks with Sonic Burst, a sharp blast of sound.
A Hatecrest Sorceress wields cold magic, hurling Frostbolt at her foes.
A Hatecrest Siren wields storm magic, hurling Lightning Bolt at her foes.
Lady Szallah is a powerful humanoid foe who calls on several spells in a fight, turning to different ones as she is wounded.
Diamond Head is a rare humanoid of Feralas who can knock foes down.
Bloodroar the Stalker is a rare beast of Feralas that unleashes a Blood Howl and flies into a rage when badly wounded.
Antilus the Soarer is a rare beast of Feralas that rends its prey.
Arash-ethis is a rare beast of Feralas that strikes with Chain Lightning and Shock.
Qirot is a rare creature found in Feralas.
Old Grizzlegut is a rare beast in Feralas.
Gnarl Leafbrother is a powerful hostile creature whose name suggests an individual identity. He attacks with Entangling Roots.
Snarler is a rare beast of Feralas.
Land Walker is one of several giants in the area. A spell called Transmogrify can change it into a Zapped Land Walker, and it attacks when hit by that spell.
Cliff Giant is one of several giants in the area. A hit from Transmogrify changes it into a Zapped Cliff Giant.
Shore Strider is a giant found near the shore. A hit from Transmogrify changes it into a Zapped Shore Strider.
Deep Strider is a giant found near the shore. A hit from Transmogrify changes it into a Zapped Deep Strider.
A Wave Strider changes into a Zapped Wave Strider when struck by Transmogrify, then attacks.
A Northspring Harpy, one of four kinds of Northspring harpy that Talo Thornhoof, a hunter once ambushed in the forest, hates and burns to avenge himself on.
A Northspring Roguefeather, one of four kinds of Northspring harpy that Talo Thornhoof, a hunter once ambushed in the forest, hates and burns to avenge himself on.
A Northspring Slayer, one of four kinds of Northspring harpy that Talo Thornhoof, a hunter once ambushed in the forest, hates and burns to avenge himself on.
A Northspring Windcaller, one of four kinds of Northspring harpy that Talo Thornhoof, a hunter once ambushed in the forest, hates and burns to avenge himself on.
Sage Palerunner is a humanoid sage in Feralas who has tasks for travelers.
A sea elemental of Feralas.
Sea Spray is an elemental of Feralas that fights with spells.
A cursed sycamore, an elemental of Feralas.
Brienna Starglow sells tailoring supplies in Feralas, where visitors can browse the goods.
A wandering forest elemental of Feralas that calls on magic when wounded.
A Grimtotem raider, one of the tauren fighters Jer'kai Moonweaver and Kindal are striking back at. It snares foes in a net.
A Grimtotem Naturalist, a tauren of Feralas whom Jer'kai Moonweaver wants driven from the Grimtotem camp. It attacks with spells and flees for help when badly wounded.
A Grimtotem Shaman, a tauren of the Grimtotem camp in Feralas that Jer'kai Moonweaver wants struck. It hurls Chain Lightning.

Innkeeper Shyria welcomes weary travelers to rest beneath her roof and asks Elune to guide their dreams. She is Quintis Jonespyre's colleague and confidante, and sends travelers to him about his Cenarion Circle morrowgrain research, asking that it be kept from the Arch Druid's ears.
Innkeeper Greul keeps an inn and tells guests they are always welcome, as the wind on the plains.

Troyas Moonbreeze is an investigator of Feralas’s ruins and artifacts. He and Angelas have studied a mysterious stave in their books, and Troyas directs research toward Daryn Lightwind, a colleague in Darnassus. His work on the Equinex Monolith leads him to identify the recovered stone as the Morrow Stone, though he is still unsure of its purpose. He continues studying it and welcomes further help.

Rockbiter was responsible for watching over Shay Leafrunner when she wandered away near the ruins. He admits he is unsure how he lost track of her and is worried about her, asking for help finding her. When she returns, he is relieved and thanks the helper, then worries aloud about what he would tell Shay’s parents if she were lost.
Kalin Windflight offers wings to help travelers get down safely.

Marli Wishrunner is a flight attendant at the Twin Colossals in Feralas, offering a one-way journey to their summit. Her conversation reflects on the changing land and regards the colossals as a constant through Feralas’s history.

Shay Leafrunner is a wandering night elf who readily loses her way while exploring Feralas. She treasures the sound of her bell, which she says will bring her back when rung, and is friends with the worried Rockbiter, whose watch she sometimes slips away from.

Gregan Brewspewer lives out in the Feralas wilderness and is known to his friend Muigin as an expert on unusual plants. He claims broad knowledge of herbs and alchemy, offers to make the Videre Elixir from an Evoroot, and helps investigate the strange Bloodpetal plants and Atal’ai Haze.

Talo Thornhoof is a seasoned hunter whose confidence was shattered by a Northspring harpy ambush; years later, he still carries a burning desire for revenge. He also studies dangerous creatures to understand their strengths, including the fel-corrupted beasts of Felwood, and worries that powerful magic such as Lethtendris's web could be misused.

Rok Orhan leads Camp Mojache's effort to push back the Gordunni, whose presence he sees as a threat to Feralas and its land. He presses the campaign from the outpost to the ruins of the High Wilderness, while investigating the ogres' dark ceremony and seeking an orb to learn more about their magic and plans.

OOX-22/FE is Oglethorpe Obnoticus’s damaged homing robot, brought back to life by its distress beacon. Its emergency power starts its ambulatory motor; its sensors flag threats and spatial danger, and it answers with evasive maneuvers or a combat plan, punctuated by mechanical clucks. Its flight systems are intended to carry it to Booty Bay.

Pratt McGrubben is a semi-retired paladin who sells leather goods and supplies. He teaches the Wild Leather armor craft, presenting its quality as second to none and insisting that good work admits no compromise. His hide-gathering commissions reflect that standard. In conversation, he grumbles that Quint keeps planting fishing grubs on him and threatens to cut down Quint’s tree with his sword.

Jangdor Swiftstrider takes pride in the quality of his leatherwork and treats it as more than a trade: he says the earth keeps secrets, and his search for fine materials has led him to thick yeti hides. He offers leather goods and teaches Wild Leather armor to skilled leatherworkers, expecting an apprentice to work through the patterns and materials with care.

Caryssia Moonhunter teaches Tribal Leatherworking as a discipline grounded in understanding primal nature. She expects accomplished Wild Leather workers to bring their finest work before beginning the next stage of training, and presents the tribal path as exclusive: those who choose it give up Dragonscale and Elemental Leatherworking. Her language frames nature as a force to appease before its power can be worked into leather.

Hadoken Swiftstrider is a veteran soldier at Camp Mojache who treats the Woodpaw gnolls as a direct threat to the camp’s survival. He notes their attacks have grown more frequent and savage, and organizes efforts to weaken them. After recognizing from a recovered map that the gnolls are also fighting a southern enemy, he investigates that conflict; he likewise sends scouts to learn whether the Zukk’ash insects are driving the gnolls’ aggression. Hadoken values reports and evidence that can help the camp hold its ground.

Latronicus Moonspear serves General Feathermoon by confronting the naga threat while protecting Feathermoon Stronghold. He aims to weaken their forces and uncover their purpose in the ruins, and sees proactive defense as compatible with the night elves’ commitment to peace. Unable to identify a mysterious relic himself, he sends it to his wife Vestia, whose scholarship may explain it.

Vestia Moonspear is Latronicus’s wife, a priestess and a widely respected scholar in their community. She investigates the mysterious relic he sends her from the Ruins of Solarsal. She judges it unlike local ruins’ objects and unlike naga design, but leaves its origin unresolved; researching it will take time.

Quintis Jonespyre is a druid and Cenarion Circle servant at Feathermoon Stronghold. He is concerned that Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm is using the Circle’s name and resources to obtain large amounts of morrowgrain, and investigates whether the herb can be used in curses, his research specialty. Quintis can use psychometry to read impressions from objects; applying it to Raschal’s knife is draining, though he hopes it will reveal what happened to the missing courier.

Ginro Hearthkindle is a Feathermoon Stronghold druid who has known courier Raschal since General Feathermoon’s expedition arrived in Feralas. After Raschal disappears on a coastal route, Ginro searches the wilds daily and returns frustrated and increasingly doubtful that he will find him. He suspects the Woodpaw gnolls may have scavenged Raschal’s belongings, but doubts they caused the disappearance; after Quintis interprets Raschal’s recovered knife, Ginro directs the search toward the gnoll camps.

Angelas Moonbreeze studies Feralas's ancient ruins with Troyas. She worries when he explores the ogre-held High Wilderness alone and quietly asks for the Gordunni there to be driven back for his safety. Afterward, she asks that her concern be kept from him. She warns that Gordunni magic harms the land and points seekers of knowledge about the Sunken Temple toward Marvon Rivetseeker, another student of ancient places.
Jewel is Troyas' pet, living alongside him in Feralas.
Jacob is Angelas' pet, living alongside her in Feralas.
A Feathermoon Sentinel serving as a guard.
Mardrack Greenwell sells food and drink in Feathermoon.
Faralorn sells general supplies in Feralas.
Harklane sells fish in Feralas.
Savanne sells fishing supplies in Feralas.
Brannock is a fishing trainer.
Vivianna is a trade supplies merchant in Feralas.
Kylanna Windwhisper is an Alchemy Trainer. She offers training, and her recorded words describe darkness spreading through the forests as a blight that threatens the world.
Xylinnia Starshine is an Enchanting Trainer who offers training. She presents enchanting as a rewarding pursuit.

Kindal Moonweaver is a night elf who joins the effort to free captured Sprite Darters from the Grimtotem. She asks for help because she and Jer'kai cannot free the dragons alone, and promises to accompany the rescue. The timed mission puts the darters' and Kindal's survival at stake; her own lines urge haste when they are in danger. Afterward, she says the rescue will not end the threat and plans to take the fight to their captors with Jer'kai.

Jer'kai Moonweaver fights the Grimtotem alongside Kindal in Feralas and welcomes help striking their camp. She warns that the clan is dangerous and unusually hostile, and wonders whether other tauren condemn its actions. She gives her signet ring to those who help, to carry to High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind in Darnassus as proof that she and Kindal are well.
Fyldren Moonfeather is a hippogryph master associated with flight travel. When threatened, he calls for the Sentinels and can summon an enraged hippogryph.
Shyn is a wind rider master associated with flight travel. When threatened, Shyn warns against defiling the sacred land and can summon an enraged wyvern.

Orwin Gizzmick is a self-interested prospector newly arrived in Feralas. He seeks Gordunni cobalt, believing the ogres bury it, and sends others to dig it up. He plans to carry the samples on his travels and sell them for a good price; he treats time as money.

Witch Doctor Uzer'i studies muisek, the spiritual power he believes can be drawn from creatures. He develops vessels and performs rituals to capture and preserve it, testing his work through a series of assignments. He also imbues captured muisek into weapons, urging their wielders to use that power well.
Lord Shalzaru is a cruel naga royal who uncovered an odd relic during a naga excavation in a cave on the Isle of Dread.
Jannos Lighthoof is a druid trainer who greets visitors in the name of the Earth Mother and wishes their ancestors to watch over them.
Loorana is a food-and-drink seller.
Kulleg Stonehorn is a skinning trainer.
Sheendra Tallgrass sells trade supplies and invites visitors to browse the goods.
Ruw is an herbalism trainer who offers instruction in herbalism.
A Camp Mojache brave.
Logannas sells alchemy supplies and invites visitors to browse the goods.
Bronk sells alchemy supplies and invites visitors to browse the goods.
Worb Strongstitch sells light armor and repairs equipment.
Miblon Snarltooth is a grumbling figure who holds a doorway until bait draws him away, then sniffs it and gnaws at it ravenously.
Cawind Trueaim is a gunsmith and bowyer whose services include goods, ammunition and repair.
Shyrka Wolfrunner is a stable master who stables travelers' pets and helps them recover lost companions.
Antarius is a stable master who stables travelers' pets and helps them recover lost companions.
Dulciea Frostmoon is a cloth armor merchant.

Hahrana Ironhide is a leatherworking trainer who says buyers must request her work in person. She prioritizes outfitting the local fighters who rely on her for armor, despite Orwin often asking her to reconsider.
Bethan Bluewater is a humanoid in Feralas who has tasks for travelers.
Blaise Montgomery is a humanoid in Feralas who has tasks for travelers.
Orik'ando is a humanoid in Feralas who has tasks for travelers.
Erik Felixe is a humanoid in Feralas who has tasks for travelers.
Paige Felixe is a humanoid in Feralas who has tasks for travelers.
Kristy Grant is a person who has tasks for travelers.
Dreamroarer is a rare dragonkin that breathes flame.
Chimaerok is a rare creature of the Isle of Dread area, whose tenderloin is sought-after meat. It spits corrosive venom, breathes lightning and swoops.
Arcane Chimaerok is a rare chimaerok variant that breathes lightning and, once badly hurt, reflects magic.

Azj'Tordin is an elder of the Shen'dralar who escaped Prince Tortheldrin's fallen court by surrendering his immortality. The imp Pusillin stole his book of incantations during that flight; Azj'Tordin considers the key Pusillin also took unimportant, but urgently wants the book recovered. He later says he seeks only freedom from the ruined halls of Eldre'Thalas.

Sage Korolusk is pursuing the fate of the elven master Kariel Winthalus, who fled Quel'Thalas with ancient artifacts and may have sought refuge in Eldre'Thalas. Korolusk asks that the search recover the knowledge Kariel carried, alive or dead, and receives reports at Camp Mojache. He identifies the night elf scholar Runethorn as his associate in the search.

Scholar Runethorn is recruiting allies from Feathermoon for the search for Kariel Winthalus, an elven master who fled Quel'Thalas carrying ancient artifacts. The inquiry follows clues to Dire Maul and seeks the knowledge Kariel carried, whether he is alive or dead. Korolusk names Runethorn as his associate in the search, which also takes reports at Camp Mojache.

Zorbin Fandazzle is a goblin engineer trying to keep a shop running on Feralas’s Forgotten Coast, despite worrying that its remote location and nearby giants and elementals make it a poor business choice. He developed an Ultra-Shrinker, which he describes as an improvement on a gnomish shrinking ray, and uses giant residue and elemental cores in his work. He is resourceful and commercially minded, offering payment and goblin contacts’ goodwill for help; his jokes and extravagant praise give him a playful, boastful manner.
Stinglasher is a hostile creature in Feralas that uses venom and lash attacks.

Emeriss is a powerful hostile dragon whose words express contempt for hope and the world’s corruption. She threatens to wither and kill the land, and invokes that corruption while attacking. Her speech presents her as an agent of destruction.

Elder Grimtotem speaks wistfully of an older life centered on hunting for glory and honor, then wonders whether the present is truly different. In a homage exchange, he accepts tribute and offers a token.
The Feralas Flame Warden represents the Alliance festival flame. He invites visitors to honor it, urges honoring Alliance fires across the lands, and denounces the Horde’s fires as unworthy.
The Feralas Flame Keeper represents the Horde festival flame. He invites visitors to honor it, urges honoring Horde fires across the lands, and denounces the Alliance’s fires as unworthy.
Xerash Fireblade prepares an herb mixture for Witch Doctor Uzer’i’s experiments and expects a shrunken head in exchange. He says he is satisfied with the head and sends herbs back to Uzer’i.

place_records.text: You are in Feralas, a contested land on Kalimdor where the Alliance and the Horde both hold settlements. The Alliance keeps Thalanaar and Feathermoon Stronghold, and the Horde keeps Camp Mojache. Grimtotem tauren, Gordunni ogres and Northspring harpies roam the wilds, and Zukk'ash insects hold the Writhing Deep.

You are in Thalanaar, an Alliance settlement in Feralas. Caryssia Moonhunter teaches tribal leatherworking here to wild leather workers who bring her their finest samples, and the druid Falfindel Waywarder calls forest spirits to aid the Charred Vale. He says the campaign against Charlga Razorflank in the Kraul must continue.

You are in Camp Mojache, a Horde camp in Feralas. Rok Orhan leads the push against the Gordunni ogres from here, and the veteran Hadoken Swiftstrider treats the Woodpaw gnolls as a direct threat to the camp, since their attacks have grown more frequent and savage. Its inn and stable master serve Horde travelers.
You are in the Grimtotem Compound, a camp of the Grimtotem tauren in Feralas. Its naturalists, raiders and shamans hold the ground, and Ironfur bears and Longtooth runners roam nearby.

You are in The Writhing Deep, a Zukk'ash hive in Feralas. Its tunnelers, wasps, workers and stingers swarm the hive, and a night elf named Raschal was once trapped inside one of its pods. Longtooth howlers and grizzled Ironfur bears prowl its edges.
You are in the Gordunni Outpost, an ogre outpost in Feralas. Gordunni brutes, ogres and ogre mages hold it, and the prospector Orwin Gizzmick wants the cobalt the Gordunni bury.

You are in Feral Scar Vale, where Feral Scar yetis roam and Bloodroar the Stalker prowls. A damaged homing robot, OOX-22/FE, belonging to the gnome Oglethorpe Obnoticus, was brought back to life by its distress beacon and waits to be moved to safety.
You are in the Frayfeather Highlands, high country in Feralas roamed by Frayfeather skystormers, stagwings and patriarchs. Antilus the Soarer is also among the hostile creatures here.

You are in the Forgotten Coast, a remote shore of Feralas. The goblin engineer Zorbin Fandazzle keeps a shop here, though he frets that its remote location, with giants and elementals nearby, makes it a poor business choice. Sea elementals and sea sprays roam the coast, and a ship transport runs to Feathermoon.
You are in Dream Bough, in Feralas. Jademir oracles, tree wardens and boughguards are its dangers, and Emeriss and Lethlas are among the hostile creatures.

You are in the Ruins of Ravenwind, ruins in Feralas that Northspring harpies and windcallers haunt. Shay Leafrunner, a wandering night elf, readily loses her way in Feralas, and her friend Rockbiter keeps watch over her.
You are in Rage Scar Hold in Feralas, where ferocious Rage Scars and Rage Scar yetis roam.

You are in Feathermoon Stronghold, an Alliance stronghold in Feralas. General Shandris Feathermoon commands the Sentinel Army from here, and Latronicus Moonspear confronts the Hatecrest naga who threaten it. Its inn and flight master serve travelers.

You are in the Ruins of Solarsal, ancient ruins in Feralas to the south of Feathermoon Stronghold. Hatecrest naga have lately occupied them in large numbers, along with Hatecrest sirens, warriors and screamers. A strange gazebo stands in the heart of the ruins.

You are in The Twin Colossals in Feralas. Marli Wishrunner offers a one-way ride to the summit, and Kalin Windflight helps travelers get back down safely. Cliff giants, land walkers and rabid longtooths roam nearby. Rockbiter fears for a lost night elf girl who wandered off into the ruins to the north. A spirit healer and a vendor are here.
You are in Sardor Isle in Feralas. Coast Crawl Snapclaws and Hatecrest warriors roam the isle, and Longtooth runners are found there too.
You are in the Isle of Dread in Feralas, where Hatecrest serpent guards and sorceresses are found. Arcane Chimaeroks and Chimaerok Devourers roam there as well.

You are in the High Wilderness of Feralas, ground held by ogres. Groddoc apes, ironfur bears and feral scars roam it, and frayfeather hippogryphs and stagwings are found too. A cursed sycamore elemental lives here.
You are in the Lower Wilds of Feralas, where Woodpaw gnolls, longtooth runners and ironfur bears roam. A spirit healer offers a return to life for a price.

You are in Lariss Pavilion in Feralas. Azj'Tordin, an elder of the Shen'dralar who gave up his immortality to escape a fallen court, lost his book of incantations to the imp Pusillin in Dire Maul. Xerash Fireblade works herbs for Witch Doctor Uzer'i nearby.

You are in the Woodpaw Hills of Feralas, where Woodpaw gnolls such as mystics, reavers and trappers roam. Gnarl Leafbrother, a powerful creature, lashes out with entangling roots. Insidious bug-like creatures are reported in the Writhing Deep, south of the gnoll camps.
You are in Woodpaw Den in Feralas, where Woodpaw mystics, reavers and an alpha roam.
You are in the Ruins of Isildien in Feralas, where Gordunni ogres, including battlemasters, warlords and shamans, are found. A spirit healer offers a return to life for a price.

You are in Dire Maul, a part of Feralas. The spirit healer here offers a return to life for a price, though cautioning that it may not yet be the traveler's time. Gordok ogre-mages, enforcers and hyenas prowl the area, alongside longtooth howlers, grizzled Ironfur bears and Rogue Vale screechers.
